self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1 Seasoned Symphony: when the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional 12%. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: An elegantly built polearm, said to have been a conductor's baton wielded by a great musician to bridge tune and taste.

refinements.1: ATK is increased by <r>12%</r>. When the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional <r>12%</r>. After initiating healing, the equipping character and the character(s) they have healed will obtain the "Sweet Echoes" effect, increasing their ATK by <r>32%</r> for 3s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

After initiating healing, the equipping character and the character(s) they have healed will obtain the "Sweet Echoes" effect, increasing their ATK by <r>48%</r> for 3s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
refinements.4: ATK is increased by <r>21%</r>. When the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional <r>21%</r>. After initiating healing, the equipping character and the character(s) they have healed will obtain the "Sweet Echoes" effect, increasing their ATK by <r>56%</r> for 3s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.
refinements.5: ATK is increased by <r>24%</r>. When the equipping character is off-field, ATK is increased by an additional <r>24%</r>. After initiating healing, the equipping character and the character(s) they have healed will obtain the "Sweet Echoes" effect, increasing their ATK by <r>64%</r> for 3s. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

fr.flavor: Une lance élégamment construite, qui aurait été un bâton de chef d'orchestre utilisé par un grand musicien pour concilier mélodie et goût.

pt.flavor: Uma lança elegante, dizem que foi a batuta de um maestro, empunhada por um grande músico para ser a ponte entre a música e o bom gosto.

refinements.1: Aumenta o ATQ em <r>12%</r>. Quando o personagem que está com essa arma equipada não estiver ativo, aumenta o ATQ em mais <r>12%</r>. Depois de curar, o personagem que está com essa arma equipada e o curado obterão o efeito "Doce Ressonância", aumentando o ATQ em <r>32%</r> por 3s. Esse efeito pode ser desencadeado mesmo quando o personagem que está com essa arma equipada não estiver ativo.

zh.flavor: 形制典雅的长枪，据说曾是某位伟大乐师在音律和味觉之间建起桥梁的指挥棒。
